checks.text: With no image loaded, the page shows the heading "Image Color Extractor", the text "Drop an image or click to browse", and the button "Browse files".
After dropping a solid red PNG file (256x256, #FF0000) into the drop zone, the swatch grid displays exactly one swatch with the hex value "#FF0000" and the label "Red".
After loading a solid red image, clicking the button "Extract colors" with the field labelled "Number of colors" set to "5" shows five swatches, all displaying "#FF0000".

After loading a solid red image and extracting 5 colors, clicking the first swatch shows the detail panel with the text "Hex: #FF0000", "RGB: 255, 0, 0", "HSL: 0, 100%, 50%", and "OKLCH: 0.62797, 0.25773, 29.22".
After loading a solid red image and extracting 5 colors, clicking the button "Copy hex" on the first swatch copies "#FF0000" to the clipboard and shows the toast message "Copied #FF0000".

After loading a solid red image and extracting 5 colors, clicking the button "Add to palette" on the first swatch adds a new swatch to the palette section with the hex value "#FF0000" and the label "Red".
After adding "#FF0000" to the palette, clicking the button "Remove" on that palette swatch removes it, and the palette section shows the text "No colors in palette".
After loading a solid red image and extracting 5 colors, the contrast ratio display shows "Contrast with white: 4.58:1" and "Contrast with black: 21.00:1".
Reload keeps the extracted palette: after adding "#FF0000" to the palette and reloading the page, the palette section still shows a swatch with the hex value "#FF0000" and the label "Red".
